text:
maya: Quick sync — I sketched a small IA tweak for the left rail. Goal: group Models + Deployments + Billing into a single Models cluster, add clearer breadcrumbs for deep links, and tighten the URL contract. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder :eyes:
kevin: can you paste the exact URL patterns you have in mind? worried about breaking external deeplinks. :thinking:
maya: rough proposal:
- /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models -> model list
- /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId -> model overview (tabs: details, deployments, metrics)
- deep links for panels: /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId?tab=deployments&panel=logs (temporary)
liz: UX nit — if we collapse Deployments under Models, customers with lots of deployments might lose discoverability. maybe a starred quick access or "Recent" section?
jonah: a11y note: when a deep link opens a panel, focus should move into the panel header and set aria-current on the selected nav item. breadcrumbs need to be keyboard-focusable. :a11y:
maya: good call. Also thinking we should prefer path-based canonical deep links rather than query strings where feasible, e.g. /models/:id/metrics vs ?tab=metrics for canonical references; queries can be used for transient UI state like open/closed panels.
eva: we have some docs and external permalinks pointing at legacy routes. what's the migration plan?
maya: plan is server-side 301s for legacy routes + client-side fallback mapping for 12 months. we'll add telemetry to measure incoming legacy hits.
dev-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-04-05 03:30 UTC :rocket:
liz: small copy thought — should the label be "Deployments" or "Runs & Deployments"? curious which is clearer for non-ML folks.
kevin: another concern: breadcrumbs will get long for nested resources (org > project > model > deployment > run). can we collapse middle crumbs with an ellipsis and show full path on hover?
maya: yes — propose collapsing when >3 levels, show tooltip with full path on hover/click. visual collapse shouldn't remove the accessible text.
jonah: for screen readers, expose the full path as an aria-label even if visually truncated. also ensure collapsed crumb still reads as "Project name > ... > Run 123" properly.
aria: :a11y: quick contrast check — current active sidebar color is borderline 3:1 against bg, need 4.5:1 for small text. add to checklist.
maya: I'll update the Figma and attach an a11y checklist. can we do a 15-min dev feasibility sync tomorrow?
kevin: free 11:30am PT.
liz: 12:00pm works for me, can flex earlier.
maya: cool. i'll send a calendar invite and open an initial PR with the routing helpers (will include a mapping table for legacy -> new paths).
jonah: add an e2e that opens /orgs/:org/projects/:proj/models/:modelId/metrics directly and asserts the metrics tab is active — catches regressions.
maya: will do. thanks all. :thumbsup:
